description: SEATS Full Student Timetable Interface Specification
unique_key_notes: EventId and Date make up the unique identifier for a scheduled class. Students scheduled on the same class should have a row per Student against the same EventId and Date.

EVENT_ID.notes: EventId and Date make up the unique identifier for a scheduled class. This field is how SEAtS distinguishes to update a lecture.

ROOM_ID.notes: If sending multiple instances, separate by forward slash. Each instance max 100 chars.

ROOM_NAME.notes: If sending multiple instances, separate by forward slash. Each instance max 300 chars.

COURSE_ID.notes: Must match COURSE_ID in Student file

COURSE_NAME.notes: Must match COURSE_NAME in Student file

COURSE_SESSION_CODE.description: Course / Programme Session Code if specified
COURSE_SESSION_CODE.notes: Replication of what is being sent in Student File. Used to distinguish same course attended by different Student Groups (Distance etc).

MODULE_ID.notes: Must match MODULE_ID in Student file

MODULE_SESSION_CODE.notes: Replication of what is being sent in Student File. Used to distinguish same module attended by different Student Groups (Distance etc).

MODULE_NAME.notes: Must match MODULE_NAME in Student file

LESSON_TYPE.notes: Default is L (Lecture) if not populated. Students are marked Attended/UnAttended against these categories.

SCHOOL_ID.notes: Equivalent to DEPT ID in Student Data Interface. Must match SCHOOL_ID in Student file.

SCHOOL_NAME.notes: Equivalent to DEPT NAME in Student Data Interface. Must match SCHOOL_NAME in Student file.

SITE_CODE.notes: If sending multiple instances, separate by forward slash. If you include a site you must include a building and room.

SITE_NAME.notes: If sending multiple instances, separate by forward slash. If you include a site you must include a building and room.

TUTOR_ID.notes: If sending multiple instances, separate by forward slash (e.g., 'BF/ PC/ PH'). Each instance max 100 chars.

TUTOR.notes: If sent, data must be sent for TUTOR_ID. Multiple tutors separated by forward slash. Name parsing: comma splits Surname first, space/dot splits FirstName first.

STUDENT_ID.notes: Must match STUDENT_ID in Student file

BUILDING_ID.notes: If sending multiple instances, separate by forward slash. If you include a building you must include a site and room.

BUILDING_NAME.notes: If sending multiple instances, separate by forward slash. If you include a building you must include a site and room.

GROUP_ID.notes: If sending multiple instances, separate by forward slash.

GROUP_NAME.notes: If sending multiple instances, separate by forward slash.

IS_MANDATORY.description: Determines if lesson is Mandatory or not
IS_MANDATORY.notes: Default is Mandatory (Y). Non-Mandatory events do not contribute to Student's Overall Attendance %. Non-Mandatory % represented on Student Calendar within Attendance Dial.

ATTENDANCE_STATUS.notes: This field must be empty except for specific cases. Sets attendance status of student. Usually empty - SEAtS manages attendance automatically based on swipes. Only used for clients that already have attendance data at source.

CLASSLINK.description: Digital content link/URL for online class (E Attend functionality)
CLASSLINK.notes: Used for SEAtS E Attend functionality. Contains digital content link displayed within Lecture Details. Captures when student clicks link to view content and marks them as attended.

DELETE.description: Flag for removing timetables at source through import
DELETE.notes: Accepts Y or N (case sensitive). If Y on a student within a timetable event, student is removed. If Y for all students in event, students and timetable are removed. Backend config must be enabled first.

VIRTUAL_ATTENDANCE.description: Flag for E Attend virtual attendance functionality
VIRTUAL_ATTENDANCE.notes: If Y, attendance status updates are applied for timetable if it has a classlink. Translates to 'Virtual Attendance' checkbox on Add/Edit Lecture Screen.

MODULE_GROUP.notes: Used in combination with MODULE_ID and MODULE_NAME. Same value as Student Data 26.MODULE_GROUP.

COLLEGE_YEAR.notes: Must match pre-existing college year in system (e.g., '2023'). If blank, defaults to current college year. Allows processing into upcoming/previous college years after Academic Rollover.

location_hierarchy.description: If you include a SITE you must include a BUILDING and a ROOM

tutor_dependency.description: If TUTOR is sent, TUTOR_ID must also be sent

multi_value_consistency.description: Fields supporting multiple values must be populated consistently on every row for a specific timetable event
multi_value_consistency.notes: Every row for every Student (for each unique event) should always be populated with the same consistent data.

settings.name: RemoveTimetable
settings.notes: Must be set to true by SEAtS (infrastructure configuration)

settings.name: RemoveStudentSchedule
settings.notes: Must be set to true by SEAtS (infrastructure configuration)

delta_handling.behavior: When enabled, if a Timetable file is imported with classes for future dates, the system determines what students are linked to the classid/date and removes only students not present in the latest file. Students still in the class remain so attendance is not affected.
